title: Caliper roadmap pillar
description: One pillar of Caliper's development roadmap and its features. Each file under roadmap/ except this one holds one pillar.

prefix.description: The three capital letters that begin the id of every feature in this pillar.

title.description: The pillar's name, as the graph's lane and the pillar page show it.

order.description: The pillar's place among the lanes, from the top, starting at 1.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the pillar covers.

id.description: The pillar's prefix, a hyphen and a number. An id never changes once it is published.

title.description: A short name in plain words, without a colon.

status.description: shipped: on main. built: finished on a branch that is not merged. planned: in a plan. idea: undecided. decision: an open question that must be settled before the features that depend on it.

summary.description: One sentence on what the feature is.

depends_on.description: The ids of the features this one directly needs. Each is an edge of the graph.

sprint.description: The sprint that builds or built the feature, when one is named: a whole sprint as a number, such as 5, or a point sprint as a quoted string, such as "3.2".

docs.description: For a shipped feature, the docs page that describes it, from the repository root, with an optional anchor.

branch.description: For a built feature, the branch where the work sits.

design.description: The design page that proposes the feature, from the repository root, with an optional anchor.

issue.description: The number of the GitHub issue that tracks the feature.

draft.description: True while the entry's dependencies are a first guess that still needs checking.
